owner_creation.analysis: FILE:src/safe_core/reserve.rs: reserve borrows a caller-owned Vec and Gate; ReserveFault owns fail_at, attempts and hits as checked scalar bookkeeping.
owner_creation.invariant: Allocation ownership remains with the supplied Vec.
limitations: These gates belong to the isolated component test crate, not the production safety-injection hook or the global allocator.

aliases_escapes.analysis: FILE:src/safe_core/reserve.rs: Both mutable borrows are scoped to the call; checked_len receives only lengths and the gate receives no reference to elements.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Gate execution cannot retain the vector element borrow.
limitations: These gates belong to the isolated component test crate, not the production safety-injection hook or the global allocator.

callback_targets.analysis: FILE:src/safe_core/reserve.rs: Gate dispatch uses &mut impl Gate and completes before try_reserve; the private Unfaulted and test ReserveFault implementations retain no callback.
callback_targets.invariant: Reserve notification is synchronous and non-retaining.
limitations: These gates belong to the isolated component test crate, not the production safety-injection hook or the global allocator.

invalidation.analysis: FILE:src/safe_core/reserve.rs: Successful Vec growth can relocate storage, but exclusive borrowing prevents callers from retaining safe element references across reserve.
invalidation.invariant: Reallocation occurs under an exclusive vector borrow.
limitations: These gates belong to the isolated component test crate, not the production safety-injection hook or the global allocator.

mutation_commit.analysis: FILE:src/safe_core/reserve.rs: checked_len checks element addition, byte multiplication and isize bound before gate or allocator; capacity-satisfied requests skip both.
mutation_commit.invariant: No allocator sees an unchecked byte-length request.
limitations: These gates belong to the isolated component test crate, not the production safety-injection hook or the global allocator.

release_pair.analysis: FILE:src/safe_core/reserve.rs: A successful reserve updates capacity of the same Vec owner; allocation failure leaves its prior storage owned and valid.
release_pair.invariant: Reserve never transfers the vector allocation to Gate.
limitations: These gates belong to the isolated component test crate, not the production safety-injection hook or the global allocator.

error_cleanup.analysis: FILE:src/safe_core/reserve.rs: try_reserve failures map to AllocationFailed; attempts uses checked_add and a one-time selected ordinal cannot wrap into a repeated hit.
error_cleanup.invariant: Failure accounting cannot repeat an old ordinal.
limitations: These gates belong to the isolated component test crate, not the production safety-injection hook or the global allocator.

signals_handoff.invariant: Reserve is not an asynchronous signal operation.
